boundary: Unchanged 20-car normal grid and seeded pothole layout. Ordinary 1/60-second updates and AI controls for all cars. No position, damage, clock, lap or RNG mutation. Class contactEpisodes count observed contact cooldown resets; collisionCount is the engine event counter. Equal-progress checkpoints use sum of each car furthest forward displacement from its initial grid position, so stopping cannot falsely improve equal-distance exposure.
